COMMENT_sensor_stabilization_delay_secs: seconds the sensor service must have been up before its reports are trusted; applied each time it (re)appears on the bus
COMMENT_hysteresis_occupied: consecutive occupied reports required before a presence=true transition
COMMENT_hysteresis_vacant: consecutive vacant reports required before a presence=false transition
COMMENT_silent: optional stricter hysteresis during a nighttime/silent window, to suppress spurious wakeups. Window is local-time HH:MM, [silent_start, silent_end); wraps midnight when start > end. Omit silent_start/silent_end to disable.
COMMENT_silent_hysteresis_occupied: consecutive occupied reports required for presence=true during the silent window
COMMENT_silent_hysteresis_vacant: consecutive vacant reports required for presence=false during the silent window
